name: New Jersey

office.name: NJDOT Oversize/Overweight Permits (SUPERLOAD system, issued for NJ MVC)

fees.note: N.J.A.C. 13:18-1.6(a): $10 for an oversize OR overweight single-trip permit; $20 when both (OS line + OW line). Valid 5 days.
$1 per foot or fraction over 14' wide (13:18-1.6(b)).

$1 per foot or fraction over 63' of trailer/load length (Guidebook Table 4; rule text says combination length over 63'). Assumes length_in is trailer/load length; tiers listed up to 151 ft (last tier: over 1800 in = $88). House trailers: over 70' instead.
$5 per 2,000 lb or fraction over the axle or gross limit, whichever excess is greater (13:18-1.6(c)); modeled on gross only - axle overages can make it higher.
13:18-1.6(d): $12 per permit transaction plus a 5% service charge on the total permit fee (the 5% is not modeled).

escorts.when: Over 14' wide, on interstates and freeways
Over 14' wide, on two-lane and other roads
Over 100' long, on interstates and freeways
Over 100' long, on two-lane and other roads

restrictions.text: Oversize permits valid sunrise to sunset only; not when visibility < 500 ft or hazardous road conditions; not on roads with < 10 ft clear passing space. Night travel only by written waiver (adds 1 escort).

No oversize travel on New Year's Day, Friday before + Memorial Day, July 4, Friday before + Labor Day, Wednesday before + Thanksgiving, Christmas; holiday on Sunday also bars Monday, on Saturday bars Friday.

Over 14' high: permittee must notify utilities, NJDOT, county and municipal traffic engineering (overhead wires, signals, bridges) along the route before the move (N.J.S.A. 39:4-28) or the permit is void.
Overweight-only (legal dimensions) permits valid 24/7; vehicles unable to do 40 mph may not run when lamps are required.
NJ permits do not cover the NJ Turnpike, Garden State Parkway or Atlantic City Expressway - separate approval from NJTA/SJTA; county/municipal roads need local permits.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

sources.title: N.J.A.C. 13:18-1 Permits for Overdimensional or Overweight Vehicles (NJDOT courtesy copy)
NJDOT Commercial Vehicle Size and Weight Guidebook (January 2024)

notes: Rule copy on NJDOT site is the MVC courtesy copy (marked 'Expires March 9, 2018'); fees/escorts match the January 2024 NJDOT guidebook - verify current N.J.A.C. 13:18-1 text.
Fees exclude the 5% service charge on the total permit fee.
No police escorts or superload category in NJ rules; only private escorts, no escort certification. Third escort (adjacent lane) used when required with night waiver.
Bridge analysis is automatic in the SUPERLOAD system; applications that overstress structures are rejected and must be rerouted or reconfigured.
